summary: Upgrades the built-in FUTO backups feature (server + web packages 1.11.5 -> 1.12.1) and swaps the restic backup binary in the Docker image for a new build with parallel scanning; adds an admin-only POST /futo-backups/onboarding/restore/continue address and a restoreJobId field in the admin onboarding status so a finished restore isn't re-offered on reload.

statements.why: New address is marked admin-only with bearer/cookie/api_key auth in open-api spec (x-immich-admin-only: true); no secret or data-loss risk visible.
Adds the restore/continue endpoint and restoreJobId field.
True, but doesn't say it replaces the restic backup binary.

statements.text: The agent also changed packages/sdk/src/fetch-client.ts, in a way plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: Generated client for the new endpoint/field.

statements.text: Test anything that uses @futo-org/backups-orchestrator-api: it was upgraded from 1.11.5 to 1.12.1.
statements.why: server/package.json bump; backups orchestration lives in this package.

statements.text: Test anything that uses @futo-org/backups-orchestrator-ui: it was upgraded from 1.11.5 to 1.12.1.

misses.what: The restic program that actually performs backups is replaced with a new build (parallel scan) in the Docker image; backups and restores should be tested end-to-end, not just the npm packages.
New admin-only step in the backup onboarding: after a finished restore, admins confirm 'continue' and the restore is no longer offered again on reload.
